scope.description: Utica Avenue from St. Johns Place to Church Avenue.

rationale: Both reviews support establishment from the exact source-explicit additive route × treatment incidence, but propose different immutable placement anchors. The stable Plan 053 application public key is already replayed with retained aliases and is invariant under later claim correction, so it is selected as the founding anchor; route/treatment IDs remain the mutable claim rather than the placement identity.
